divergences.spec_says: f-ui-shell: Navigation includes links for all feature areas
divergences.actually_did: No navigation links. This is a single-page game with one URL and state-based transitions. There are no routes or feature-area pages to link to.
divergences.rationale: The product has zero navigation by design (vision.json scope.out includes 'multi-page routing', design pass-1 confirms 'No navigation. Single page, single URL.'). Navigation links would be scope creep.

divergences.spec_says: f-ui-shell: Error boundaries catch and display errors / Loading states exist for async operations
divergences.actually_did: No error boundaries or loading states implemented. The product has no async operations, no network requests, no data fetching. Page renders instantly from static HTML (<100KB).
divergences.rationale: Design pass-2 five-state analysis confirms: 'No loading state in the traditional sense — entire game is client-side with zero data fetching' and 'No error states exist in this product — no network requests, no API calls.' Error boundaries and loading states are structurally unnecessary.

factory_decisions.decision: Vanilla HTML/CSS/JS with no framework, no bundler, no transpiler
factory_decisions.context: Infrastructure manifest explicitly specifies framework type 'none'. Vision scope declares 'zero dependencies' as a portfolio signal.
alternatives_considered: Vite + vanilla — rejected: adds build step, node_modules dependency tree, complexity with no user benefit for a <100KB static page
factory_decisions.rationale: The absence of a framework IS the design. Clean source code viewable with View Source. Sub-100KB total weight. No build step required. Vitest used for dev testing only — not shipped.

factory_decisions.decision: Inter from Google Fonts CDN with font-display: swap
factory_decisions.context: Design pass-3 specifies Inter as the single typeface. Infrastructure manifest confirms Google Fonts source.
alternatives_considered: Self-hosted Inter — rejected: adds file management, same result, Google CDN has better cache hit rates
System font stack only — rejected: design spec requires a specific typeface for portfolio-quality typography
factory_decisions.rationale: Inter is free, CDN-cached, excellent legibility, wide weight range. font-display: swap prevents FOIT. Preconnect hints for fast loading.

factory_decisions.decision: CSS custom properties on :root for all design tokens (no preprocessor)
factory_decisions.context: Design pass-3 provides exact color values, typography scale, spacing grid. Need a token system for consistency.
alternatives_considered: CSS preprocessor (Sass/Less) — rejected: adds build step, violates no-framework constraint
Inline values everywhere — rejected: no single source of truth, harder to maintain
factory_decisions.rationale: Native CSS custom properties work in all modern browsers, no build step, tokens are inspectable in DevTools, single source of truth matching the design spec exactly.

factory_decisions.decision: State management via data-state attribute on game container, CSS-driven visibility
factory_decisions.context: Game has 5 states (ready, playing, revealing, game-over, deck-complete). Elements show/hide per state.
alternatives_considered: Class-based toggling per element — rejected: verbose, error-prone, requires JS for every show/hide
JS-driven display toggling — rejected: CSS can handle state-based visibility declaratively
factory_decisions.rationale: Single data-state attribute controls all visibility via CSS selectors [data-state="X"] .element { display: none }. Game logic only needs to call setAttribute once per state change. Clean separation of concerns.

factory_decisions.decision: Card back uses CSS repeating-linear-gradient crosshatch pattern
factory_decisions.context: Design pass-3 specifies 'repeating diagonal lines or crosshatch using repeating-linear-gradient' with base #3D3632 and accent rgba(245, 240, 235, 0.08).
alternatives_considered: SVG pattern — rejected: adds asset, more complex
Solid color — rejected: design spec says 'not a solid color', must register as intentional
factory_decisions.rationale: Pure CSS, zero file weight, matches spec exactly. Two overlapping 45deg/-45deg repeating gradients at 8px spacing with 1px accent lines.

factory_decisions.decision: Vitest + jsdom for testing (dev dependency only, not shipped)
factory_decisions.context: Need test infrastructure for TDD. Product is vanilla JS but tests need DOM environment.
alternatives_considered: No tests — rejected: TDD is required by foundation protocol
Jest — rejected: vitest is faster, native ESM support, lighter config
Playwright/browser tests — rejected: overkill for unit/DOM tests at this stage
factory_decisions.rationale: Vitest gives fast test execution with jsdom environment. Tests read the actual HTML/CSS files and parse them. 26 tests run in <500ms. Not included in production build.

factory_decisions.decision: Card flip uses CSS 3D transform with perspective 1000px, 400ms cubic-bezier(0.25, 0.1, 0.25, 1.0)
factory_decisions.context: Design pass-3 interaction spec defines exact flip parameters. Foundation scaffolds the CSS; game-logic stories trigger it.
alternatives_considered: JavaScript animation — rejected: CSS transforms are GPU-accelerated, simpler, match the spec
Web Animations API — rejected: CSS is sufficient and more maintainable for a single transform
factory_decisions.rationale: CSS 3D transforms with backface-visibility: hidden on both faces. Flip triggered by adding .flipped class to .card-inner. Easing decelerates like a physical card. Foundation provides the CSS plumbing; feature stories add the trigger logic.

factory_decisions.decision: Test fixtures provide SUITS, VALUES, makeCard(), makeDeck(), and sampleCards for all feature tests
factory_decisions.context: Feature stories need consistent card data for testing. Deck model tests need a full 52-card deck. Comparison tests need specific card pairs.
alternatives_considered: Inline test data per test file — rejected: duplication, inconsistency
JSON fixture files — rejected: less flexible than JS functions that generate test data
factory_decisions.rationale: Exported functions and constants that feature tests import. makeCard(value, suitIndex) produces any card. makeDeck() produces a full 52-card deck. sampleCards provides named realistic examples (Ace of Spades, Seven of Hearts, etc.).

factory_decisions.decision: github-pages-config: static deployment with flat file structure at root
factory_decisions.context: Infrastructure manifest specifies github-pages deployment. No build step, no output directory — files served directly from root.

decided.reason: No framework, no build step. index.html, style.css, game.js served directly from root. .nojekyll file present. GitHub Pages Source = gh-pages branch.

factory_decisions.rationale: Simplest possible deployment. No basePath needed since files are at root. .nojekyll prevents Jekyll processing.
